blocks.arabic_text: ﷺ مِنْ أَهْلِ نَجْدٍ ثَائِرَ الرَّأْسِ نَسْمَعُ دَوِيَّ صَوْتِهِ وَلَا نَفْقَهُ مَا يَقُولُ حَتَّي دَنَا فَإِذَا هُوَ يَسْاَلُ عَنِ اْلإِسْلَامِ، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ: خَمْسُ صَلَوَاتٍ فِي الْيَوْمِ وَاللَّيْلَةِ، فَقَالَ: هَلْ عَلَيَّ غَيْرُهَا؟ قَالَ: لَا، إِلَّا أَنْ تَطَوَّعَ، قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ: وَصِيَامُ رَمَضَانَ، قَالَ: هَلْ عَلَيَّ غَيْرُهُ؟ قَالَ: لَا، إِلَّا أَنْ تَطَوَّعَ، قَالَ: وَذَكَرَ لَهُ رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ الزَّكَاةَ قَالَ: هَلْ عَلَيَّ غَيْرُهَا؟ قَالَ: لَا، إِلَّا أَنْ تَطَوَّعَ، قَالَ: فَأَدْبَرَ الرَّجُلُ وَهُوَ يَقُولُ: وَاللهِ لَا أَزِيدُ عَلَي هذَا وَلَا أَنْقُصُ، قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ: أَفْلَحَ إِنْ صَدَقَ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه البخاري باب الكزاة من الاسلام رقم:٤٦
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Talhah ibn Ubaidullah (RA) narrates, “A man from the region of Najd, with dishevelled hair, came into the presence of the Prophet ﷺ. (Because he was far away) we could only hear the faint sound of his speech. We could not understand his speech clearly. Meanwhile, he came near the beloved Prophet ﷺ, and we understood that he was asking about “Islam (its deeds)’. The Prophet ﷺ (replying to his question) said, “Five (Fard) Salahs in the day and night.” He asked, “Apart from this, are any other Salahs Fard (obligatory) upon me?’ The Prophet ﷺ replied, “No! However, if you wish to pray Nafl, you may pray.” Then the Prophet ﷺ said, “The fasting of Ramadan is obligatory.’ He asked, “Apart from this, is any other fast obligatory upon me?” He said, “No! However, if you wish, you may keep Nafl fasts.” (After this) the Prophet ﷺ spoke about Zakat. He asked, “Apart from Zakat, is any other charity obligatory upon me?’ The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, “No, however, if you wish, you may give Nafl charity.’ “By Allah,
